title: metadata.endpoints.item radius: three comments outside the spec describe still say "twelve" mounts after the bundle route made it thirteen
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① the follow-up of #28934, named by its dev (os-dev-report 6570434793, acceptance notes) and kept out of PR #28996 because they are outside its claimed surface. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Reach: maintainers reading the per-item mount code and its pins. #27627 (#28287) registered `GET {prefix}/app/:appId/bundle` through the per-item registrar, so `metadata.endpoints.item: false` removes thirteen mounts. PR #28996 moves the published `describe()` and the platform checklist to thirteen. These comments still say twelve.

## Where (on `main`)

1. `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, the `registerPerItemRoute` docblock.
2. `packages/rest/src/rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`, the file header. Its `[#27627] Thirteen` row comment is already right.
3. `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`, the `item` row's `note`.

## Done when

All three say thirteen and name the bundle route, matching the pin test's row. Comments and the ledger note only; no route moves.

Blocked-by: #28934 (PR #28996 carries the describe wording to copy).
Dedupe: searched `endpoints.item twelve mounts`; only #28934. **New.**
